body: The child's shoe and the water bottle are tied in one bundle with torn red cordon tape, the quarantine kind. A paper tag with an evacuation sector code hangs from the knot, and a second tag with a struck-through sector code hangs beneath it—both bearing the same emergency authority stamp.
title: Child's shoe and water bottle, Tuesday dawn

body: My sister came in from the treated rows with burning eyes and blistered hands. Her work clothes reeked of the spray. By evening three neighbors who never entered the field had the same burning eyes.
title: Harvest at the stretcher
